Please read this User Agreement carefully before using the services provided by Fun App Ltd ("the Company").

Fun App is designed and developed to help people form introductions, build friendships and discover group activities. This document forms a legally binding agreement between you and the Company governing your access to and use of the mobile application, website, and associated services (collectively, "the Service").

## 1. Structure & Governing Law

1.1. This Agreement, its subject matter and its formation (including any non-contractual disputes or claims) are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of England and Wales.

1.2. The courts of England and Wales shall have exclusive jurisdiction to settle any dispute or claim arising out of or in connection with this Agreement.

1.3. Nothing in this Agreement shall affect your statutory consumer rights under the laws of England and Wales, including the Consumer Rights Act 2015 and the Consumer Contracts (Information, Cancellation and Additional Charges) Regulations 2013.

## 2. Eligibility, Age Gate & Mandatory ID Verification

2.1. The Service is strictly intended for adults aged 18 and over. By registering an account and gaining limited initial access to the Service, you represent and warrant that you are at least 18 years of age.

2.2. Before you are granted access to any social functionality - including but not limited to connecting, messaging, joining group activities, hosting events, or accessing user profiles - you must successfully complete the Company's mandatory age and identity verification process.

2.3. Verification requires submitting a valid government-issued photo ID (e.g., passport or driving licence) and completing a real-time biometric liveness check via the Company’s designated third-party identity verification provider. If verification fails or is incomplete, social features will remain entirely locked.

2.4. Mandatory identity and age verification services are conducted by a third-party data processor, Didit (or another appointed identity verification provider), acting on behalf of the Company. While the Company does not directly store raw copies of your government-issued identification documents or facial biometric scans on its core application servers, Didit securely hosts and retains this verification data under strict data protection standards, and verification records remain accessible to the Company through Didit for safety audits, legal compliance, and enforcement of user bans.

2.5. By using the Service, you represent and warrant that you have never been convicted of a violent or sexual offense, nor that you are subject to any notification requirements under the Sexual Offences Act 2003 or similar legislation worldwide.

## 3. Subscriptions, Pricing & Promotional Offers

3.1. Access to full Here & Now membership functionality of the Service is priced at £11 per month (inclusive of VAT, where applicable).

3.2. Six-Month Initial Free Here & Now membership: The first 100,000 accounts registered within six (6) months of Service launch in the UK, in February 2027, will receive consecutive months of free Here & Now membership until the end of month six (6) of Service launch. Payment information will be required at the time of registration. Upon expiration of the free period, the standard subscription rate of £11 per month will apply automatically unless cancelled prior to the end of the trial period, in accordance with Clause 3.5.

3.3. Venue Partner Accounts:

* Authorised representatives of venues, clubs, businesses or partner organisations ("Venue Partners") may register B2B Venue Partner accounts. Venue Partner accounts are maintained strictly for managing venue profiles, operating hours, capacity, event listings, and exclusive perks or discounts offered to Fun App users.
* Venue Partner accounts are entirely separate from consumer user accounts. Venue Partner account holders are not subject to consumer dating matchmaking features, consumer profile creation rules or consumer Didit biometric verification workflows through their professional account credentials.
* By registering a Venue Partner account, you represent and warrant that you have full legal authority to act on behalf of the named organisation and bind it to these Terms.

3.4. 'Founding Friend' Lifetime Offer:

* The Company may offer the opportunity to purchase a lifetime membership pass known as 'Founding Friend' status before the official Service launch or within six (6) months of Service launch in the UK.
* The purchase, availability, eligibility criteria, entitlement rights, transfer limitations, refund conditions and specific terms governing the 'Founding Friend' pass are set forth in a separate agreement entitled "FUN APP FOUNDING FRIEND PURCHASE TERMS & CONDITIONS", which will be presented to and must be accepted by the user at the point of purchase.
* In the event of any conflict or inconsistency between the terms of this Agreement and the FUN APP FOUNDING FRIEND PURCHASE TERMS & CONDITIONS regarding the 'Founding Friend' offer, the FUN APP FOUNDING FRIEND PURCHASE TERMS & CONDITIONS shall prevail solely to the extent of that conflict.

3.5. Standard subscriptions renew automatically on a monthly basis until cancelled by the user via app marketplace settings (Apple App Store / Google Play Store) or direct platform billing settings. In order that the Company can keep its administration in step with every change, cancellations must be made at least 48 hours prior to the end of the current billing cycle to avoid charge.

3.6. In-line with UK consumer laws, you have the right to cancel your purchase within 14 days without giving any reason. For digital content and immediate service activation, you expressly request that service delivery begins immediately upon purchase; if you cancel during the 14-day window after using the Service, you will be charged a pro-rata amount for the period used.

## 4. Partner Venues, Discounts & Third-Party Offers

4.1. The Service enables users to access discounts, promotional offers and to host/attend events at independent third-party commercial venues ("Partner Venues").

4.2. Partner Venues operate independently of the Company. The Company does not own, manage or operate any Partner Venue and is not responsible for:

* The availability, quality, or safety of food, drink or entertainment supplied by Partner Venues.
* A Partner Venue’s refusal to honour an in-app discount, offer or event reservation due to capacity, operational issues or breach of venue entry conditions.
* The enforcement of licensing laws, age checks or venue-specific entry policies by Partner Venue staff. A verified profile on Fun App does not represent evidence of a user’s over 18 status for Partner Venue purposes.

4.3. When visiting a Partner Venue or participating in an event held at a venue, you agree to comply with all rules, conditions and regulations enforced by the venue. Reported abuse of Partner Venue staff or failure to comply with venue policies will result in investigation and possible restriction or termination of your account under Clause 7.

## 5. Group Activities & Offline Meetups

5.1. The Service facilitates online matchmaking, group social planning and in-person meetups. You acknowledge that attending in-person dates, casual hangouts or group activities carries inherent risks. You voluntarily assume all risks associated with in-person interactions.

5.2. Fun App was created as a warm, welcoming and respectful environment for its users and the Company will continuously moderate user behaviour on the Service and provide tools such as Safe Guard and Footprint to increase user safety. The Company cannot, however, verify the background or ongoing conduct of its users beyond the initial identity check conducted pursuant to Clause 2. You are solely responsible for taking reasonable safety precautions when meeting other users in-person and the Company urges you to always do so. All content review mechanisms, moderation procedures, automated filtering, triage systems and enforcement actions (including warnings, feature restrictions, account suspensions, permanent bans and device-level blocks) are carried out in accordance with the Company’s separate **Content Review and Moderation Controls Policy**.

5.3. Users who organise or host group activities via the Service act independently and not as representatives, employees or agents of the Company. Group hosts must detail and collect all ticket or attendance fees at point of user booking via the Service and are strictly prohibited from collecting fees from attendees during an event or for any event listed as free.

## 6. User Content & Conduct Standards

6.1. You agree that you will not use the Service to upload content or engage in behaviour that:

* Is unlawful, defamatory, harassing, abusive, threatening or hateful.
* Contains nudity, sexually explicit material or commercial pornography.
* Involves scams, financial solicitation, commercial advertisement or event promotion outside the rules of the Service.
* Impersonates any individual or misrepresents your age or identity.

6.2. You retain ownership of all intellectual property rights in the content, photos and messages you submit to the Service. You grant the Company a worldwide, royalty-free, non-exclusive licence to host, store, display, and reproduce such content solely for the purpose of operating and providing the Service.

## 7. Moderation, Suspension & Account Termination

7.1. The Company reserves the right to investigate, temporarily suspend or permanently terminate any user account without refund if, in the Company's reasonable opinion:

* You have breached any provision of this Agreement or Community Guidelines.
* Your identity verification status is found to be fraudulent, altered or misleading.
* You engage in misconduct, abuse, harassment or safety violations - whether online or during an in-person meetup/event.

7.2. Upon permanent account termination resulting from a material breach of this Agreement, all active subscriptions, unused promotional periods and Founding Friend status are forfeited immediately without entitlement to a refund.

## 8. Limitation of Liability

8.1. Nothing in this Agreement shall exclude or limit the Company's liability for:

* Death or personal injury caused by the Company’s negligence.
* Fraud or fraudulent misrepresentation.
* Any other liability that cannot be excluded or limited under the law of England and Wales.

8.2. Subject to Clause 8.1, the Company shall not be liable to you, whether in contract, tort (including negligence), or breach of statutory duty, for any loss of profit, loss of goodwill, loss of opportunity, or indirect or consequential loss arising under or in connection with the Service or any in-person user interactions.

8.3. Subject to Clauses 8.1 and 8.2, the Company's maximum total aggregate liability to you in respect of all losses arising under or in connection with this Agreement shall be limited to the higher of: (a) £100, (b) the total subscription fees paid by you to the Company in the six (6) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim or (c) the total purchase price paid by you for a Founding Friend pre-launch package (where applicable).

## 9. General Provisions

9.1. A person who is not a party to this Agreement has no right under the Contracts (Rights of Third Parties) Act 1999 to enforce any term of this Agreement.

9.2. If any court or competent authority finds that any provision of this Agreement (or part of any provision) is invalid, illegal or unenforceable, that provision or part-provision shall be deemed deleted and the validity and enforceability of the remaining provisions shall not be affected.

9.3. The Company may amend this Agreement from time to time. Users will be given reasonable notice of any material changes before they take effect.

## 10. Contact & Complaints

For questions, safety inquiries or formal complaints regarding the Service, please contact the Company at:

* **Email:** support@funapp.world
* **Address:** 167-169 Great Portland Street, 5th Floor, London, United Kingdom, W1W 5PF
